response.sql: SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice WHERE Total >= 3.98

assumptions.assumption: "total threshold of 3.98" means invoices with Total >= 3.98 (at or above the threshold). "Threshold" commonly denotes a minimum cutoff, and >= is the standard interpretation unless otherwise specified.

alternatives.interpretation: Threshold means strictly greater than: invoices with Total > 3.98 (excludes exactly 3.98)
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice WHERE Total > 3.98

alternatives.interpretation: Threshold means at or below: invoices with Total <= 3.98 (if threshold is a maximum rather than minimum)
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice WHERE Total <= 3.98
